h1: Samchook Resort — a budget cottage-style stay near the 100-year Sam Chuk market
intro: If you're coming to walk the 100-year Sam Chuk Market and want a cheap, no-frills place that's still comfortable and a few minutes' drive from the market — Samchook Resort (Samchuk Resort) is a tidy fit. It's a budget resort in Sam Chuk District where the rooms are houses and cottages dotted around a garden. What guests consistently mention is a quiet, peaceful feel, clean rooms, low prices, friendly staff and free parking, with rates from around ฿590/night. It's not an upscale resort, but it delivers a relaxed, countryside-home feel on a very easy budget.
galleryAlts: Houses and cottages of Samchook Resort Sam Chuk set in a leafy garden
Simple, clean room with air-conditioning, TV and a fridge at a budget price
Garden corner and common sala seating area with a quiet atmosphere

body.html: Samchook Resort is at 131 Moo 1, Sam Chuk Sub-district, Sam Chuk, around 2-3 km from the Sam Chuk district office, reached via Highway 2094 — a budget resort that's close to the town centre but feels quiet and shady, like a countryside home. The property has around 37 rooms, both twin rooms in the main building and standalone houses/cottages in the garden. What reviewers like is the calm and the very low price, which suits anyone here mainly to walk the Sam Chuk market and just wanting a good-value place to sleep, not luxury.

The rooms earn praise for being clean and simply practical for the price. They come with air-conditioning, TV, a mini-fridge, water heater, drinking water and an en suite bathroom. Rooms in the main building have flat-screen TVs and exposed brick walls, while the cottage rooms have wood-panelled walls for a warmer feel. Because many of the rooms are standalone houses, privacy is higher than at a typical block hotel — a good fit for couples or small families who want their own space.
"Nice atmosphere, peaceful and quiet, clean rooms, good value, friendly staff — a relaxed base for walking the Sam Chuk market."

What guests appreciate is the friendly service and the shady garden. There's an on-site restaurant, breakfast is available, Wi-Fi is free throughout, and parking is free. A garden and a sala seating area make a nice spot for a morning coffee in the breeze. Overall it feels more like staying at a relative's countryside house than at a hotel — well suited to anyone wanting a warm, informal place on a budget.

Worth knowing before you book: parts of the access lane are bumpy and uneven — several reviews mention this, so drive slowly and you'll be fine. The rooms and amenities are basic in line with the price; there's no swimming pool or gym, so anyone expecting a full-facility resort should adjust expectations. And because it sits by a garden, you may get a few insects in the rainy season or at dusk — packing some mosquito repellent makes sitting outside more comfortable.

The Sam Chuk location suits anyone here to walk the 100-year Sam Chuk Market and do the cultural sights around here. It's about 1 km to Wat Sam Chuk and around 2 km to the 100-year market, with the Khun Chamnong Chinarak House Museum and old coffee shops in the market within easy reach — then you can push on to Bueng Chawak or the Don Chedi Monument the next day. Being in the Sam Chuk area means you can get in and out of the market easily without a long drive.

The honest verdict from real reviews: Samchook Resort is a budget, countryside-home stay with quiet, clean rooms and friendly service at a very low price — ideal for drivers visiting Sam Chuk who want good value near the market. You do have to accept a somewhat bumpy access lane, basic amenities and the odd insect from the garden. But if the brief is a cheap stay near the 100-year Sam Chuk market, this is genuinely good value.

faq.q: Where is Samchook Resort and how far is the Sam Chuk market?
faq.a: It's at 131 Moo 1, Sam Chuk Sub-district, Sam Chuk, Suphan Buri, reached via Highway 2094 — about 1 km from Wat Sam Chuk and around 2 km from the 100-year Sam Chuk Market (a 3-5 minute drive). It's right in the Sam Chuk area, so it's easy to come and go, ideal for drivers visiting the historic market.

faq.q: How much does Samchook Resort cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿590/night for a twin room in the main building. There are also rooms with breakfast included and standalone house/cottage rooms for more privacy. Prices vary by date and platform, so always compare a few sites before booking.

faq.q: Who is Samchook Resort best for?
faq.a: It's best for budget travellers driving to Sam Chuk who want a good-value bed near the historic market. It's a budget, countryside-home resort with clean, quiet rooms and free parking. It's not ideal if you expect a resort with a pool, full facilities or a perfectly smooth access road.

faq.q: Does the resort have parking and breakfast?
faq.a: Yes, there's free on-site parking and breakfast is available (included in some rooms). Since nearby shops may not open early, having breakfast and parking helps a lot if you're driving yourself — check at booking whether your chosen room includes breakfast.

faq.q: What's the access road like and is it quiet?
faq.a: Several reviews note that parts of the access lane are bumpy, so drive slowly; if your car is very low, ask the resort about the route first. Overall the atmosphere is quiet and private thanks to the garden house-style rooms, making it a relaxed place to unwind.
